beats.care: Going from Panvel or Belapur? Plan a bus or cab to Vashi. Western Railway has no block today.
beats.what: Harbour line: no Panvel–Vashi trains from 11:05 am to 4:05 pm. Thane–Kalyan 5th and 6th lines: block from 9 am to 1 pm.
beats.why: Central Railway uses Sunday blocks for engineering and maintenance work on tracks and signals.

cards.body: Locals between Panvel and CSMT and trans-harbour trains between Panvel and Thane are cancelled in this window.
cards.caption: Harbour block, 11:05 am to 4:05 pm

cards.body: Deccan Queen, Sinhagad and Pragati Express are among trains moved to the fast lines between Thane and Kalyan. They may run 10–15 minutes late.
cards.title: Express trains too

opts: Take the Harbour local as usual
Get to Vashi another way, then take a special
cards.q: You need to go from Panvel to CSMT at 1 pm. What's the smart move?
cards.why: Panvel–Vashi is blocked till 4:05 pm, but special locals run between Vashi and CSMT.

hook: Is your *Harbour line* train running this Sunday afternoon?

learn.t: During the Harbour block, Thane–Vashi and Thane–Nerul trans-harbour trains still run, and specials run between CSMT and Vashi.
